capabilities: List notes that link to a date on that day in any year
Detect born and died badges from keywords and lifespan pairs
Embed an on-this-day code block in any note, including daily notes
Browse and step through days in a sidebar panel
Skip daily-note navigation lines and bookkeeping label lines
disambiguation: Not a recurring-task or reminder scheduler; it only resurfaces date links already in your notes on their yearly anniversaries.
extras: Read-only and fully local (no network requests). The author notes it has only been run on Obsidian 1.15 on macOS and iOS, though no platform-specific APIs are used. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer.
motivation: The author wanted anniversaries from dates already written in ordinary notes, with no new syntax, properties, or separate list to maintain.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to surface anniversaries and past events from date links already scattered through a vault, without tagging or maintaining a separate list.
summary: An on-this-day plugin that lists notes whose date links fall on the selected day, in a sidebar panel or an embeddable block.
